task.title: Turn on Nearby
task.shortdesc: Nearby uses Bluetooth and your iPhone's local network to find people close by. You turn it on once, the first time you open the Nearby tab.

taskbody.context: Each explanation screen ends with Continue, and the iPhone permission prompt appears right after it.

step.stepresult: The Turn on Nearby sheet explains what phones around you can see. For the details, see .

step.info: To decide later, tap Not now.

step.cmd: On OMNI uses Bluetooth, tap Continue, then allow Bluetooth in the iPhone prompt.
step.info: If you say no, you won't see anyone and nobody will see you.

step.cmd: On One more question from your iPhone, tap Continue, then allow to find devices on your local network.
When Hear when someone says hi appears, tap Continue and allow notifications.
step.info: This appears the first time someone shows up on Nearby, or before your first hi. While the app is open, it plays a sound and shows a banner when someone says hi.

taskbody.result: The top of Nearby shows Looking for people nearby…, then the number of people here. People appear when they're within about 30 metres with open.
taskbody.postreq: Nearby has no off switch once it's on. To stop new people from seeing you, turn on Hide me. See .
